reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that previews file edits as line-level diffs and requires approval before selected write, edit, or replace-editor tools execute.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中预览文件编辑的逐行差异，并在指定写入工具执行前请求用户批准或拒绝。
summaries.en: Previews line-level diffs for file edits in DeepSeek Harness and requests approval before selected write-family tools execute.

capabilities: Reads target file contents to compute proposed edit diffs
Intercepts write-family tool calls before execution
Presents approval controls and can allow or reject an edit
Provides settings and a host command to enable or disable edit approval
